originalTitle: Nigeria's president orders manhunt after kidnappers upload victim video
title: Helping Our Friends: Everyone is Looking for Missing People in Nigeria!
content:
Hello, Super Friends!

Hi there, awesome kids! It's me, your friendly reporter, here to share some important news from our big continent, Africa! Today, we're talking about our friends in Nigeria, a wonderful country with many amazing people and places. Sometimes, sad things happen, and some grown-ups and children went missing from their homes. This made many people in Nigeria very sad and worried. But don't worry, super helpers are on the case!

Our President is Helping!

Did you know that every country has a leader called a President? In Nigeria, the President is like a very important helper who makes sure everyone is safe and happy. When he heard about the missing people, he felt very sad too. So, what did he do? He told everyone to start a super big search! He wants all the grown-ups and children who went missing to come back home safely. This means many, many people are working together to find them. He wants the police, who are like brave helpers in uniforms, and the soldiers, who are also very brave and protect everyone, to look everywhere. They are looking in forests and different places to find our missing friends and bring them back to their families. It's like a giant game of hide-and-seek, but a very serious one, where everyone wants to find the hidden people quickly.

Who Are Our Missing Friends?

Some grown-ups and many children were taken away from their homes. We saw a picture that made everyone feel sad, but it also made everyone want to help even more! It showed them sitting together, waiting to come home. Imagine if your friends or family went missing. You would want everyone to help find them, right? That's exactly how people in Nigeria feel now. Everyone is thinking about these people and hoping they will be safe soon. Did you know? Nigeria is a very big country in West Africa. It has so many different languages and cultures, like a rainbow of people! It's often called the 'Giant of Africa' because of its large population and land size.

Working Together to Find Them

When something sad like this happens, it's amazing to see how everyone works together. The President is asking everyone to help. This means that police officers, soldiers, and even regular people in the community are joining hands. They are all trying their best to find clues. They are talking to people, looking at places, and trying to understand what happened. It's like a big puzzle, and everyone is trying to find the missing pieces so that the missing people can be safe again. It takes a lot of hard work and courage to do this kind of search. But everyone knows how important it is to bring children and grown-ups back to their families. Families miss them very much!

Why Do People Do Bad Things?

Sometimes, a few people do bad things that make others sad or scared. We don't always understand why, but it's important to remember that most people in the world are good and kind. The people who took these grown-ups and children away are doing something wrong. But the good news is that many, many more people are working hard to fix this wrong. They want to make sure everyone is safe and that bad things don't happen. Did you know? In Nigeria, people love music and dancing! They have many different types of music and festivals where everyone celebrates together. It's a land full of joy and rhythm!

Keeping Safe at Home and School

Even though this news can sound a bit scary, it's also a good time to remember how important it is to stay safe. Here are some simple safety tips: * **Always tell a grown-up where you are going.** Whether you're playing outside or going to a friend's house, tell your parents or a trusted adult. * **Stay with your group.** If you're out with your family or friends, try to stay close to them. * **Know your grown-up's phone number.** It's a good idea to remember your parent's phone number, just in case. * **Don't talk to strangers.** If someone you don't know tries to talk to you or give you things, always say no and tell a grown-up immediately. * **If you ever feel unsafe, tell a trusted adult.** This could be your mom, dad, teacher, or another grown-up you trust. These simple rules help keep all children safe, not just in Nigeria, but all over the world!

Hope for Tomorrow!

Everyone in Nigeria, and many people around Africa and the world, are sending good thoughts and prayers to the missing people and their families. They are all hoping for a happy reunion very soon. When we all work together, we can do amazing things. The President, the police, the soldiers, and the community are all showing us how important it is to care for each other. We will keep you updated on this story, super friends! Let's all wish for the safe return of our missing friends in Nigeria. Together, we are strong! Remember to always be kind, be brave, and stay safe!
summary: Nigeria's President has ordered a big search to find grown-ups and children who went missing, with many brave people like police and soldiers working hard to bring everyone home safely.
whyMatters: This story matters because it shows how leaders and communities work together to help people in need, especially children, and reminds us all about the importance of safety and caring for each other.

originalTitle: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
title: Sharing Oil, Making Rules!
content:
Hello, Amazing Explorers!

Hi everyone! It's your friendly news reporter here, ready to share a story from far, far away. Imagine our world is like a big playground, and countries are like different groups of friends. Sometimes, friends have different ideas or rules. Today, we're talking about some grown-up countries and their talks about something very important: oil and trade!

Meet Our Countries!

First, let's meet our main characters! There's a really big country called **America**, or the United States. It's very far from us, across the ocean. America is like a leader in some games on the playground. Then there's another super big country called **China**. China is also far away, in Asia. They make lots of toys and clothes that we sometimes see in our markets! And then we have **Iran**. Iran is a country in a part of the world called the Middle East. It's a place with lots of history and beautiful things. Did you know? Africa has 54 countries! That's a lot of friends on our continent!

What is Oil and Why is it Important?

Now, let's talk about something super important called **oil**. Imagine a dark, thick liquid found deep under the ground. That's oil! It's like magic because we use it for so many things. Oil helps make the fuel for our cars, our buses, and even airplanes that fly high in the sky! It helps lights stay on and makes machines work. Countries need a lot of oil to keep everything running. Did you know? The first oil was found a very, very long time ago! People used it for light before electricity.

Countries Trading Together

Think about when you share your lunch with a friend, or when your parents buy food at the market. That's a kind of trade! Countries also trade with each other. They buy and sell things. One country might have lots of oil, so they sell it to another country that needs oil. This helps everyone get what they need. It's like sharing toys or treats. When countries trade, they become partners, helping each other. Iran has lots of oil, and China needs lots of oil for its cars and factories. So, Iran sells its oil to China. This is good for both of them!

Rules for Countries: Sanctions

Sometimes, countries have different ideas about how things should be done. Imagine if some kids on the playground made rules, and another group of kids didn't like those rules. America has made some special "rules" or "punishments" for Iran. These are called **sanctions**. It's like saying, "If you do certain things, we won't let you trade easily with us, or with our friends." America wants Iran to change some of its actions. So, America is telling other countries, "Please don't buy oil from Iran." Did you know? Sanctions are a grown-up way for countries to try and make another country follow certain rules, without having a big fight.

China and Iran are Friends

But here's the thing: China and Iran have been trading oil for a very long time. They are like old friends who help each other. China buys a lot of oil from Iran. This oil helps China power its many cars and factories. So, when America says "don't buy oil from Iran," China says, "Hold on! We like trading with Iran. They are our partners, and we need their oil."

Why is China Upset?

China thinks America's new rules, these sanctions, are not fair. China says these rules are "illegal," which means they think America is not allowed to make such rules for other countries. It's like if one friend told another friend, "You can't play with *that* friend anymore!" China wants to keep buying oil from Iran because it's good for their country. They believe every country should decide for itself who to trade with. They don't want to be told what to do. Did you know? China is the country with the most people in the world! Imagine how many cars and homes need electricity there!

What Happens When Countries Don't Agree?

When America makes these rules, it also says it might "isolate" countries that keep trading with Iran. To "isolate" means to make a country feel alone, like no one wants to play with them. It means it would be harder for these countries to buy and sell things with America and its friends. This makes things tricky because it's always better when countries are friends and can work together. Everyone needs friends! When countries disagree, they try to talk about it and find a way to be fair to everyone. It's just like when you and your friends have a small argument – you talk it out, right?

Why Should We Care?

You might be thinking, "What does this mean for us in Africa?" Well, when big countries talk about trade and rules, it can affect the whole world! Prices of things like oil can change, and that can affect how much it costs to drive our cars or even how much things cost in the shops. It reminds us that being kind and fair to everyone, even if they are far away, is so important. When countries are friends and trade fairly, everyone benefits! It helps bring peace and helps all our countries grow strong. Let's hope these countries can talk things through and find a happy way forward, just like good friends always do!
summary: America has made new rules that make it harder for countries to buy oil from Iran, but China thinks these rules are unfair because China likes to trade with Iran.
whyMatters: It's important because when big countries disagree about trade, it can affect how much things cost everywhere, and it reminds us that everyone should try to be fair and friendly.
